ko: 이제부터는 실전이다.\n난세에서, 우리는 과연 어떤 업을 이루게 될 것인가……!
en: The stakes have never been higher. We all must decide—in these dark times, what will we achieve? What will our legacy be?!
...It's time for you to go back to where you came from. Go, before your body gets any colder.

ko: 돌아가면, 이 일은 책이와 권이에게도 말해 주어야겠다.
en: Once I return, I'll tell Ce and Quan everything.

ko: 모두, 내 등을 보고 쫓아오시오!\n내가 길을 만들어 주겠소!
en: Everyone, stay behind me and follow my lead! I will make a path!
Everyone, please...lend me your strength. We must hurry and leave this place.

ko: 하지만 그것도 잠시,\n이제 하던 일을 마무리 지어야 할 때다.
en: But that didn't last, and now it's time to finish things.

ko: 마침 새로운 경기가 시작되려 하는군요.\n조금 멀찍이 떨어져 봐야겠습니다.
en: It looks like a new match is about to start. Let's take a step back and watch how this unfolds.

ko: 당연하지.\n언니만 이런 위험한 곳에\n내버려 둘 순 없으니까.
en: Of course. I'd never let any sister of mine hang around in a dangerous place like this.

ko: 좋아요.\n저 또한, 언제 다시 이곳을 찾더라도 만족할 수 있게끔, 잘 다듬어 두도록 할 테니까요.
en: Good. And I will see to it that this place is properly maintained, so that it will stand ever ready for your return.
